name: What are the different methods for surface smoothing?
description: Methods include troweling, grinding, and self-leveling compounds for concrete, and applying and sanding plaster or drywall compounds for walls.

mainEntity.name: What are the different methods for surface smoothing?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common methods for surface smoothing vary by material. For concrete, techniques include troweling (hand or power), grinding, and self-leveling compounds. Troweling creates a dense, smooth finish, while grinding removes high spots and prepares for coatings. Self-leveling compounds are poured to create a perfectly flat surface over an existing uneven one. For walls, plaster or drywall compounds are applied and sanded to achieve a seamless finish, removing imperfections before painting.
